goal: Review a code sample, report material issues, and make changes only when the user explicitly asks for edits and the files are available.

requirements.text: Apply changes only if explicitly requested and permitted

exclusions.text: Do not produce an extensive expert-style essay

assumptions.statement: The requested review should focus on problems, not a broad tutorial.

verification: Do not claim edits or tests unless completed and confirmed.
note: Illustrative task interpretation only; not a trace of hidden reasoning and not proof of execution.
